note: ICD-10 cerebrovascular chapter I60-I64: subarachnoid, intracerebral and other non-traumatic intracranial haemorrhage, cerebral infarction, stroke not specified. TIA (G45) is not a stroke and is not included.

Pulmonary embolism I26, phlebitis and thrombophlebitis including DVT I80, portal vein thrombosis I81, other venous embolism and thrombosis I82. I26 is on the DDXPlus list (pulmonary embolism), so the map reaches it first.
Arterial embolism and thrombosis I74, including mesenteric (I74 excludes cerebral and coronary, which are the stroke and MI rows).
Aortic aneurysm and dissection I71 (all sites; ICD-10-CM I71.0x is dissection).
Acute and subsequent MI. On the DDXPlus list (Possible NSTEMI / STEMI); listed for completeness.
Streptococcal sepsis A40, other sepsis A41, and ICD-10-CM severe sepsis R65.2.
J12-J18 pneumonia block. On the DDXPlus list (pneumonia); listed for completeness.
Bacterial and other meningitis G00-G03, encephalitis and myelitis G04-G05, meningococcal infection A39, viral encephalitis A83-A86, viral meningitis A87, herpes simplex encephalitis B00.4.
G06 covers intracranial and intraspinal abscess and granuloma; the row names spinal abscess (G06.1), and we take the whole category because the AHRQ ED list pairs spinal and intracranial abscess.
Acute and subacute endocarditis I33, endocarditis valve unspecified I38, endocarditis in diseases classified elsewhere I39.
